label: late original-phase input of l/p/i/x/3/1/o/z/s/r
explanation: Fires only during the original (encoding) phase, almost never at t<3, the <DEL> step, or anywhere in the copy phase (2 of 64k dev activations). The rate climbs with absolute position: from 1% at t=2 to about 40% at orig_idx 8, so longer sequences carry more of the mass. Strongly token-selective: l (4.5x lift) and p (4.2x) are top, then i, x, 3, 1, o, z, s, r. It is more likely on the first occurrence of a token (in_first: 85% of mass). Largest activations are l/p inputs at t=6-8 just before <DEL>, often in runs of consecutive active steps. Magnitude is not obviously modulated by L beyond position. Precision is limited (about 0.5): the same tokens at late positions are often inactive, so some unidentified history dependence is missing (e.g. first token e/y raises the rate).
